service_account_key_ref.description: 1Password reference to the service-account JSON (op://<vault>/<item>/<field>). NEVER a raw secret per ADMINISTRATEME_BUILD.md §L1.

oauth_credentials_ref.description: Secure-provider reference to installed-app OAuth JSON containing client_id, client_secret, and refresh_token. Configure one independently authorized instance for each member account.

provider_account_id.description: Stable AdministrateMe alias for this member's Google account; usually the Google email address.

workspace.description: Exact reviewed isolation workspace for this account.

read_only.description: When true, request only calendar.readonly and expose no provider write capabilities.

calendar_id.description: Google Calendar id (e.g. 'primary' or a calendar-list entry id) the adapter polls and writes to.

discover_calendars.description: Discover and synchronize the authorized account's calendar list. Calendar capability facts are projected separately from per-member scheduling rules.

include_calendar_ids.description: Optional allowlist applied after calendar-list discovery.

exclude_calendar_ids.description: Optional quarantine list for test, probe, or otherwise irrelevant calendars.

user_email.description: The Google Workspace user the service account impersonates (domain-wide delegation subject).

poll_interval_s.description: In-process inbound-poll cadence in seconds. Defaults to 60s; pack.yaml's cron is a heartbeat the supervisor uses to detect a wedged adapter.

sensitivity_floor.description: Adapter sensitivity floor. Config may RAISE the floor but cannot LOWER it below the hardcoded class default per SYSTEM_INVARIANTS.md §6 invariant 10.
